title: Batch's Bedwars Modpack
description: A Lightweight Optimized Bedwars Modpack specifically for Performance and Utilities.
body:
# BBMP
***A customizable, performance-first Minecraft 1.8.9 Forge modpack designed specifically for Hypixel Bedwars.***

**BBMP** *(Batch's Bedwars Modpack)* is a lightweight collection of mods that improve FPS, reduce lag, and add useful Bedwars Quality of Life and Utility mods. Whether you're grinding Hypixel Bedwars as a new player starting off, or a professional wanting even more FPS, BBMP aims to provide a customizable experience while keeping the game lightweight and optimized.

---

## What BBMP Does For You

BBMP tightens up every layer of Minecraft 1.8.9's performance by rewriting the lighting engine, skipping unnecessary chunk loads on world join, culling entities hidden behind walls, and stripping memory waste from the JVM — so you spend less time stuttering in lobbies and more time actually playing. On top of that, it layers in a clean suite of Bedwars-specific utilities: live session stats, a resource inventory overlay, automatic end-of-game GG messages, a fully customizable crosshair, persistent auto-sprint, and a visual hitbox display for sharper PvP reads. Everything is configurable in one place via OneConfig (Left Alt + R), so you can use exactly what you want without touching config files.

---

## Mods

## Performance

| Mod | What It Improves | What It Adds |
|-----|-----------------|--------------|
| **PolyPatcher** | Dozens of vanilla 1.8.9 bug fixes and engine-level optimizations in a single mod | Smart disconnect, image link preview, inventory scale, clean main menu, parallax fix |
| **Entity Culling** | Stops rendering entities and block entities hidden behind walls using async path-tracing on spare CPU threads | Per-entity visibility config, tick culling whitelist |
| **FoamFix** | Reduces Java heap memory usage by up to 50% through targeted JVM and model loading optimizations | Nothing gameplay-facing; purely under the hood |
| **Phosphor** | Rewrites the lighting engine for significantly faster chunk loading and reduced CPU usage | Nothing gameplay-facing; purely under the hood |
| **Ksyxis** | Eliminates the 441 unnecessary spawn chunks Minecraft loads on every world join | Nothing gameplay-facing; purely under the hood |
| **IdleTweaks** | Reduces CPU and GPU usage when the game window is idle or tabbed out | Configurable FPS cap while unfocused |

## Gameplay

| Mod | What It Improves | What It Adds |
|-----|-----------------|--------------|
| **Bedwars Mod** | Replaces the default Hypixel scoreboard and HUD with Bedwars-aware overlays | Session stat tracker, resource inventory overlay, player stat viewer (`/bw`), team member status display |
| **AutoGG Reimagined** | Removes the need to manually type end-of-game messages | Customizable GG message, optional second message, configurable send delay, per-game toggle |
| **Essential & Not So Essential** | Provides the OneConfig framework required for all Polyfrost mods to function | Shared config UI (LALT + R), mod compatibility layer |
| **PolyHitbox** | Fixes vanilla hitbox rendering inconsistencies | Toggle keybind, always/hovered/toggled display modes, dashed lines, outline, eye height line, view ray |
| **PolyCrosshair** | Fixes vanilla crosshair centering issues | Custom crosshair shape, size, color, centered alignment option, toggle keybind |
| **PolySprint** | Removes sprint key hold requirement | Auto-sprint toggle, sneak toggle, configurable via OneConfig |

---

## Requirements

- **Forge** 1.8.9
- **Left Alt + R** — opens OneConfig (mod settings)
- Recommended: 2GB+ allocated RAM
